# TidyPanel

> Local tabular data cleaning for AI agents. An R package and JSON CLI for
> supported CSV, Excel, TSV, TXT and RDB tables, with local artifacts and an audit.

The cleaning step makes zero model calls and consumes zero AI inference tokens.
Agent instructions and shared results can still consume tokens. R 4.1 or later
and the matching installed public package are required. Four tiny fictional CSV
demos are included; no AI API key is needed.

Run `Rscript --vanilla exec/tidypanel.R describe` from the source root for the
current request schema, limits and example request templates. Use
`Rscript --vanilla exec/tidypanel.R clean --request request.json` for a job.
Keep full observations local and previews off unless sharing is authorized.

This is a repository documentation index, not automatic agent registration,
a hosted API or an MCP server. Resolve relative links from this file's directory.

## Start Here

- [Agent guide](AGENTS.md): setup, invocation, result handling and privacy.
- [README](README.md): value, installation, quick start and supported boundaries.
- [Four-example guide](vignettes/TidyPanel_introduction.Rmd): workflows using only the bundled fictional CSV demonstrations.
